title: 第9章 暗流下的微光 下第10章 风满楼 上
slug: 修仙开局一部手机修为全靠买
content_zh:
两人在院子里对着练了整整一个上午的剑。松枝对松枝，没有灵力碰撞，纯粹的剑招切磋。苏清欢偶尔出言指点，每一次都直击要害，精准地抓到刘叙白发力方式上的毛病。而刘叙白的悟性也确实不差，往往苏清欢说一遍他就能领悟七八成，再多练几遍就能基本掌握。
虽然那只是松枝互缠，但他能感觉到，苏清欢在借画梅宗的剑理，帮他补《悟道剑诀》基础三式中的缺漏。这种指点对于没有正经师承的散修来说，在某些方面比他独自闷头苦练几个月都管用。
日头升到头顶的时候，刘叙白停下来喘了口气，额头上已经冒了一层细汗。苏清欢倒是面不改色，把松枝扔回柴火堆，拍了拍手上的灰，又坐回石墩上翻她那本旧书去了。
刘叙白看着她的背影，忽然问道：“你以前在画梅宗教过弟子？”
苏清欢翻书的手指顿了一下，然后继续翻页，语气淡淡的：“带过几个师妹。”
“难怪。”刘叙白点了点头。能带师妹的，在宗门里至少也是内门弟子以上的级别。苏清欢在画梅宗的地位，恐怕比他之前猜的还要高一些。但她在黑松林里中的毒几乎要了她的命，说明她离开画梅宗的过程绝不是什么好聚好散。
他没有继续追问。每个人都有自己的秘密和伤疤，苏清欢不主动说，他就不会主动揭。这是两个人之间心照不宣的默契。
中午随便吃了点干粮，下午刘叙白决定去镇子外面的野地里采些草药。他和苏清欢两个人身上的灵石加起来也只够维持几天的日常开销，坐吃山空不是办法。黑松林那种险地暂时不敢再去了，但青石镇周边一些安全地带还是能找到些低品级的草药，积少成多，也能换几个灵石。
苏清欢留在镇上，刘叙白一个人背着竹筐出了镇子。
冬天的野地里一片枯黄，大部分草木都在雪下蛰伏着，只有一些耐寒的草药还在石缝和崖壁上顽强地露着头。刘叙白花了小半个时辰，在镇东边的一片荒坡上找到了几株霜叶草——这种草药不值钱，但镇上药铺常年收购，一株能换一枚下品灵石。他小心翼翼地挖了七株，又在一块大石头底下翻到一丛干巴巴的石斛，品相一般，但聊胜于无。
过了约莫一个时辰，天色渐渐暗了下来，他刚在一处石壁上抠完最后一株石斛准备往回走，竹筐里忽然传来一阵极轻微的震动。
他低头一看，是手机在震。
刘叙白心里一紧。墟市从来不会主动通知他，只有在一种情况下才会有动静——他之前设定的某个安排被触发了。他掏出手机，屏幕亮起，一条简洁的文字浮现在墟市界面中：“灵识标记，下品，距离已超出感知范围。”
标记脱离感知范围，说明携带标记的人已经离开了以他为中心的某个半径。他在前天早上设下这道标记的时候，选择将灵识附着在陈砚那件粗布短打的袖口上。当时并没有想太多，只是一枚灵石的收费实在太便宜，他便多留了一个心眼。
现在标记显示脱离，意味着陈砚已经到了极远的地方。
刘叙白站在荒坡上，握着手机的手微微收紧。他不知道画梅宗具体在哪里，苏清欢说过“东南，千里”。如果标记在这个距离上才超出感知范围，说明陈砚至少已经在千里之外了。那个吊着一条断臂、背着一个破包袱的身影，真的在两天之内走了那么远的路。
他把手机收好，背起竹筐，快步往青石镇的方向走去。
回到镇上时天色已近黄昏。刘叙白先去药铺把今天采的草药卖了，七株霜叶草加一丛石斛，总共换了九枚下品灵石。他把灵石收好，又去粮铺买了两斤米和一小块腊肉，准备晚上熬一锅腊肉粥。
推开院门的时候，他愣了一下。
苏清欢不在石墩上。院子里多了一个人——一个穿着青色粗布裙的少女，大约十五六岁的年纪，梳着两条麻花辫，圆脸，冻得通红，正局促不安地站在院子角落里。苏清欢站在她旁边，正低声跟她说着什么。看到刘叙白进来，苏清欢朝他招了招手。

“这是阿宁——你不在的时候我给你说过的那个丫头。”苏清欢的语气里带着一丝解释的意味，“镇上张婶的闺女，家里揭不开锅了，张婶想把她送到隔壁镇的绣坊去当学徒，又怕路上不安全，托我帮着照看两天。”
刘叙白点了点头，把竹筐放下，朝那个叫阿宁的少女笑了笑：“饿不饿？晚上熬腊肉粥，一起吃点。”
阿宁怯生生地点了点头，又飞快地摇了摇头，显然是拘谨的厉害。苏清欢拍了拍她的肩膀，难得地放柔了声音：“没事，他不是坏人。”
刘叙白没再多说，转身进了灶房淘米切肉。腊肉切成薄片，和米一起下锅，又加了点干菇和姜丝。灶膛里的火重新燃起来，橘红色的火光从灶口透出来，把半间灶房都映暖了。
阿宁坐在院子里的石墩上，起初还缩着肩膀不敢动，苏清欢在她旁边坐下，也不说话，只是把磨刀石和青锋剑拿过来，继续磨剑。沙沙的磨剑声节奏均匀，像是一种无声的安抚。过了一会儿，阿宁的肩膀慢慢松了下来，开始好奇地打量院子里的陈设，目光在刘叙白腰间那柄裂纹剑上停了一下，又飞快地移开了。
腊肉粥熬好的时候，天已经彻底黑了。刘叙白盛了三碗端出来，腊肉的咸香和米粥的绵软混在一起，上面飘着几片翠绿的野葱——那是他在野外采药时顺手拔的。阿宁端着粥碗，先是小口小口地抿，后来大概是实在饿了，喝粥的速度明显加快，一碗很快见了底。刘叙白又给她盛了一碗，她接过去的时候，眼圈忽然红了一下。
“谢谢刘大哥。”她的声音很小，但比刚才响亮多了。
刘叙白摆了摆手，端着粥碗坐在院子门槛上，抬头望着头顶的星空。今晚的星星比昨晚多，密密麻麻铺满了整个天幕，银河像一条泼出去的牛奶河，从南到北横贯天际。
苏清欢端着粥碗走到他旁边，靠在门框上，也抬头看着那片星空。
“在想什么？”她问。
“在想砚子到哪了。”刘叙白喝了一口粥，“他走得快，已经在千里之外了。”
苏清欢偏过头看了他一眼，似乎是好奇他怎么会知道。
刘叙白没有解释，只是低头喝粥。苏清欢也没有追问。阿宁在院子里帮忙收拾碗筷，手脚麻利，一看就是穷人家的孩子，做惯了活计的。她一边收碗一边偷偷打量刘叙白和苏清欢，圆圆的脸上浮起一丝若有若无的笑意，大概是觉得这两个人之间的气氛很奇怪——不像兄妹，不像夫妻，但又比普通朋友亲近得多。
星空下，这个破败的小院被灶膛残余的火光染上一层温暖的橘色。石桌上放着三副空碗筷，灶台上剩余的半锅粥还在冒着热气，墙角的柴火垛上蹲着一只不知道从哪来的花猫，正用爪子洗脸。
刘叙白喝完最后一口粥，把碗放在脚边，忽然笑了一下。
“笑什么？”苏清欢低头看他。
“想起以前。”他说，“以前我也是这么过日子的。下班回家，做一顿饭，吃完了看会儿电视，然后睡觉。那时候觉得这种日子平淡得要命，恨不得每天都能发生点什么刺激的事。”
“现在呢？”
“现在觉得，能平平安安吃一顿饭，就是好日子。”刘叙白站起来，拍了拍屁股上的灰，接过阿宁递过来的空碗，朝灶房走去。走到门口，他回头看了苏清欢一眼。
“等砚子回来，等阴阳门的事过去了，我给你们做红烧肉。”

苏清欢靠在门框上，星光落在她的侧脸上，勾勒出一个柔和到近乎不真实的轮廓。她没有说话，只是轻轻地点了点头。
阿宁在一旁擦桌子，看看这个又看看那个，终于没忍住，小声问苏清欢：“苏姐姐，刘大哥以前是做什么的呀？”
苏清欢看了灶房里那个正在刷锅的背影一眼，嘴角弯了弯。
“他啊。在另一个世界里，修电脑的。”

content_en:
The two of them practiced sword fighting in the yard all morning. Pine branches versus pine branches, there is no collision of spiritual powers, just a pure sword fight. Su Qinghuan occasionally gave advice, but every time he hit the point, he accurately caught the shortcomings in Liu Xubai's way of exerting force. And Liu Xubai's comprehension is indeed not bad. He can often understand 70% to 80% of what Su Qinghuan says once, and he can basically master it after practicing a few more times.
Although it was just an entanglement of pine branches, he could feel that Su Qinghuan was borrowing Hua Mei Zong's sword theory to help him fill in the gaps in the three basic movements of the "Enlightenment Sword Technique". This kind of guidance is more effective in some aspects for a casual cultivator who doesn't have a serious teacher than if he has to practice hard alone for several months.
When the sun rose above his head, Liu Xubai stopped to take a breath, and there was already a layer of sweat on his forehead. Su Qinghuan didn't change her expression. She threw the pine branches back into the firewood pile, patted the ashes on her hands, and sat back on the stone pier to read her old book.
Liu Xubai looked at her back and suddenly asked, "Have you ever been a disciple in Huamei Religion before?"
Su Qinghuan's fingers while turning the book paused for a moment, then continued to turn the pages, saying in a calm tone: "I have taken care of several junior sisters."
"No wonder." Liu Xubai nodded. Those who can take care of junior sisters must be at least an inner disciple or above in the sect. Su Qinghuan's status in the Plum Painting Sect may be higher than he had previously guessed. But the poison she was poisoned in the black pine forest almost killed her, which shows that her departure from the Painted Plum Sect was by no means a happy reunion.
He did not continue to ask. Everyone has their own secrets and scars. If Su Qinghuan didn't take the initiative to tell them, he wouldn't take the initiative to reveal them. This is an unspoken understanding between the two people.
After eating some dry food at noon, Liu Xubai decided to go to the wild fields outside the town to collect some herbs in the afternoon. The combined spiritual stones he and Su Qinghuan had were only enough to sustain daily expenses for a few days, so sitting on their hands was not an option. I dare not go to dangerous places like the Black Pine Forest for the time being, but you can still find some low-grade herbs in some safe areas around Qingshi Town. If you accumulate a little, you can exchange it for a few spiritual stones.
Su Qinghuan stayed in the town, while Liu Xubai left the town alone carrying a bamboo basket.
In winter, the fields are all withered and yellow, and most of the grass and trees are dormant under the snow. Only some cold-resistant herbs are still stubbornly showing their heads on the stone crevices and cliffs. It took Liu Xubai half an hour to find a few frost-leaf grasses on a barren slope east of the town. This herb was not valuable, but the town drugstore bought it all year round, and one plant could be exchanged for a low-grade spiritual stone. He carefully dug out seven plants, and found a clump of dry dendrobium under a big rock. It was of average quality, but better than nothing.
After about an hour, the sky gradually darkened. He had just finished digging out the last dendrobium on a stone wall and was about to walk back when a very slight vibration suddenly came from the bamboo basket.
He looked down and saw that his phone was vibrating.
Liu Xubai felt nervous. The market will never take the initiative to notify him. There will only be news under one circumstance-a certain arrangement he set before is triggered. He took out his mobile phone, the screen lit up, and a simple text appeared on the market interface: "Spiritual Mark, low grade, the distance has exceeded the range of perception."
When the mark is out of the perception range, it means that the person carrying the mark has left a certain radius centered on him. When he set up this mark the morning before yesterday, he chose to attach his spiritual consciousness to the cuffs of Chen Yan's coarse cloth jacket. He didn't think too much about it at the time, but the price for a spiritual stone was too cheap, so he kept an extra thought in mind.
The mark now shows separation, which means that Chen Yan has reached an extremely far place.
Liu Xubai stood on the deserted slope, his hand holding the phone slightly tightened. He didn't know where exactly the Painted Plum Sect was. Su Qinghuan once said, "Thousands of miles to the southeast." If the mark is beyond the range of perception at this distance, it means that Chen Yan is at least a thousand miles away. That figure hanging with a broken arm and carrying a broken burden, reallyThat's a long way to go in two days.
He put away his mobile phone, picked up the bamboo basket on his back, and walked quickly towards Qingshi Town.
It was almost dusk when we returned to town. Liu Xubai first went to the drug store to sell the herbs he picked today, seven frost-leaf grasses and a clump of dendrobium, for a total of nine low-grade spiritual stones. He put the spirit stone away and went to the grain store to buy two kilograms of rice and a small piece of bacon, preparing to make a pot of bacon porridge at night.
When he pushed open the courtyard door, he was stunned for a moment.
Su Qinghuan is not on the stone pier. There was one more person in the yard - a girl in a blue coarse skirt, about fifteen or sixteen years old, with two braids, a round face, red from the cold, standing awkwardly in the corner of the yard. Su Qinghuan was standing next to her, whispering something to her. Seeing Liu Xubai come in, Su Qinghuan waved to him.
"This is Aning - the girl I told you about when you were away." Su Qinghuan said with a hint of explanation in her tone, "Aunt Zhang's daughter in this town is in trouble at home. Aunt Zhang wants to send her to the embroidery workshop in the next town to be an apprentice, but she is afraid of being unsafe on the road, so she asked me to take care of her for two days."
Liu Xubai nodded, put down the bamboo basket, and smiled at the girl named Aning: "Are you hungry? Make bacon porridge tonight and eat some together."
Aning nodded timidly and shook his head quickly, obviously very cautious. Su Qinghuan patted her shoulder and said in a rare soft voice: "It's okay, he is not a bad person."
Liu Xubai didn't say anything more, turned around and went into the kitchen to wash rice and cut meat. Cut the bacon into thin slices, add it to the pot with rice, and add some dried mushrooms and shredded ginger. The fire in the stove ignited again, and the orange-red fire light shone from the stove mouth, warming half of the stove room.
Aning sat on the stone pier in the yard, hunching her shoulders at first and not daring to move. Su Qinghuan sat down next to her and didn't speak. She just took the whetstone and Qingfeng sword and continued to sharpen the sword. The rustling sound of sword sharpening was evenly rhythmic, like a silent comfort. After a while, Aning's shoulders slowly relaxed, and he began to look at the furnishings in the yard curiously. His eyes stopped for a moment on the cracked sword on Liu Xubai's waist, and then quickly moved away.
By the time the bacon porridge was ready, it was completely dark. Liu Xubai filled three bowls and brought them out. The salty aroma of bacon and the softness of rice porridge were mixed together, with a few pieces of green wild onions floating on them - which he had picked while collecting herbs in the wild. An Ning held the bowl of porridge and sipped it in small sips at first. Then, probably because he was really hungry, he drank the porridge faster and the bowl quickly reached the bottom. Liu Xubai served her another bowl. When she took it, her eyes suddenly turned red.
"Thank you, Brother Liu." Her voice was small, but much louder than before.
Liu Xubai waved his hand, sat on the threshold of the yard with a bowl of porridge, and looked up at the starry sky above his head. There are more stars tonight than last night, densely covering the entire sky. The Milky Way is like a river of milk spilled out, across the sky from south to north.
Su Qinghuan walked to him with a bowl of porridge, leaned against the door frame, and looked up at the starry sky.
"What are you thinking about?" she asked.
"I was wondering where the inkstone was." Liu Xubai took a sip of porridge. "He walked very fast and was already thousands of miles away."
Su Qinghuan turned her head and glanced at him, as if she was curious about how he knew.
Liu Xubai didn't explain, just lowered his head and drank the porridge. Su Qinghuan did not ask further questions. Aning helped clean up the dishes in the yard. He was very agile and he looked like he was a child from a poor family and was used to doing hard work. As she put away the bowl, she secretly looked at Liu Xubai and Su Qinghuan. A faint smile appeared on her round face. She probably felt that the atmosphere between the two people was strange - not like brother and sister, not like husband and wife, but much closer than ordinary friends.
Under the starry sky, this dilapidated courtyard was dyed a warm orange color by the remaining firelight from the stove. There are three pairs of empty dishes and chopsticks on the stone table, and half of them are left on the stove.The pot of porridge was still steaming, and on the pile of firewood in the corner squatted a tabby cat who didn't know where it came from, washing its face with its paws.
Liu Xubai drank the last mouthful of porridge, put the bowl at his feet, and suddenly smiled.
"What are you laughing at?" Su Qinghuan looked down at him.
"Remembering the past," he said, "I used to live like this. I would go home from get off work, cook a meal, watch TV for a while, and then go to bed. At that time, I felt that this kind of life was extremely dull, and I wished that something exciting could happen every day."
"What now?"
"Now I feel that if I can have a meal in peace, it is a good life." Liu Xubai stood up, patted the ashes on his butt, took the empty bowl handed over by Aning, and walked towards the kitchen. When he reached the door, he looked back at Su Qinghuan.
"When Yanzi comes back, and when the Yin Yang Sect incident is over, I will make braised pork for you."
Su Qinghuan leaned against the door frame, and the starlight fell on the side of her face, outlining an outline that was so soft that it was almost unreal. She didn't speak, just nodded slightly.
Aning was wiping the table aside, looking at this and that. Finally, she couldn't hold it back and asked Su Qinghuan in a low voice: "Sister Su, what did Brother Liu do before?"
Su Qinghuan glanced at the figure who was cleaning the pot in the kitchen, and the corners of her mouth curved.
"He. In another world, he repairs computers."
